_comment: Labels used by the SONUC ILANI (result announcement) published on EKAP once a tender is concluded. Data, not code (CLAUDE.md rule 5) - the parser is English, the words it looks for are Turkish because the source page is.
_contract_section: The announcement repeats the same label in more than one section: '1- İhalenin a) Tarihi' is the tender date, '4- Sözleşmenin a) Tarihi' is the contract date. Everything below is read from the contract section onwards, so the two never get confused.
_bid_count: Sits above the contract section, under '3- Teklifler', so it is read from the whole text.
_item_letters: The announcement is a lettered list flattened into one line: 'a) Tarihi : 16.07.2026 b) Bedeli : ...'. A value ends where the next letter starts. Kept here because a regex character class with ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş, ü in it would be a Turkish string inside a .cs file.
_winner_labels: EKAP bu satırı yeniden adlandırdı: eskiden 'Yüklenici', şimdi 'Yüklenicisi'. Yenisi başta, eskisi arşivdeki eski ilanlar için duruyor. İki nokta etiketin hemen ardından gelmeli, yoksa 'Yüklenicinin uyruğu' tutar.
